messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Your doctor may stop Hydrochlorothiazide.
Do not stop taking HCTZ on your own without speaking to your doctor first.
This is not a complete list of side effects and others may occur.
Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects.
You may report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has reporting instruction", "you may report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088"]

The relation 'has reporting instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has specific instructions provided for reporting adverse effects or issues, as specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has reporting contact': The subject drug has a designated contact entity specified by the object for reporting side effects or adverse events.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'requires prescriptions to be reported to': The subject entity mandates that prescriptions for the drug be reported to the object entity.
D. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
E. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
